Route Registrations from App.tsx (lines 83–85) ```tsx } /> } /> } /> ``` All three routes currently render the same inline `Placeholder` component defined at the bottom of `App.tsx` (lines 104–113): ```tsx function Placeholder({ title }: { title: string }) { return (

No `Assets.tsx`, `Query.tsx`, or `Reports.tsx` exist. --- ## 2. Component Files for /ops/assets, /ops/query, /ops/reports **None exist.** These are stub routes — they do not import any component files and instead share the generic `Placeholder` inline function in `App.tsx`. The titles passed are: - `/ops/assets` → `"Asset Registry"` - `/ops/query` → `"Natural Language Query"` - `/ops/reports` → `"Risk Profile Reports"` --- ## 3. Sidebar/Nav File — `/src/components/Sidebar.tsx` (full content read above) Key structural points: **Nav items are defined as three static arrays at the top (lines 23–42):** ```ts const opLinks = [ { to: "/ops", icon: SquaresFour, label: "Command Center" }, { to: "/ops/floor-plan", icon: MapTrifold, label: "Floor Plan" }, { to: "/ops/incidents", icon: Warning, label: "Incidents" }, { to: "/ops/import", icon: ArrowsClockwise, label: "Import Pipeline" }, { to: "/ops/ingress", icon: Pulse, label: "Ingress Data" }, { to: "/ops/assets", icon: Desktop, label: "Assets" }, // ← stub { to: "/ops/query", icon: MagnifyingGlass, label: "NL Query" }, // ← stub { to: "/ops/reports", icon: ChartBar, label: "Reports" }, // ← stub ]; const supLinks = [ ... ]; // supervisor links const techLinks = [ ... ]; // tech links ``` **Link selection** is role-driven (line 79): ```ts const links = role === "ops" ? opLinks : role === "supervisor" ? supLinks : techLinks; ``` **Active state** uses `NavLink` with `end` set only on root paths (`/ops`, `/supervisor`, `/tech`), so child routes like `/ops/assets` match without `end`. Active items get `bg-white/[0.07]` background, filled icon weight, and white text. **Responsive behavior:** - Desktop (`md:`): static `
` at `w-[216px]`, always visible - Mobile: slide-in drawer triggered by `MobileHeader`'s hamburger button in `App.tsx`; uses `framer-motion` for `x: "-100%"` → `x: 0` animation with a backdrop overlay Icons are from `@phosphor-icons/react`. --- ## 4. Layout Wrapper for /ops **There is no dedicated layout component for `/ops`.** The layout is applied directly in `App.tsx`'s `AppRoutes` function (lines 68–101): ```tsx
setDrawerOpen(false)} />

` scroll container. There is no React Router ``-based nested layout — each page component is fully responsible for its own internal padding and structure. --- ## 5. Data Available in `src/data/mock.ts` ### `assets: Asset[]` — 58 assets total across 3 floors **Structure:** ```ts interface Asset { id: string; // e.g. "chiller-a-03", "rack-a01" name: string; // e.g. "CHILLER-A-03", "RACK-A01" type: string; // "Power" | "Cooling" | "Compute" | "Network" status: "normal" | "warning" | "critical" | "offline"; x: number; // floor-plan percentage position y: number; criticality: "high" | "medium" | "low"; floor: "Mechanical" | "Hall A" | "Hall B"; zone: string; // e.g. "Electrical", "Chiller Plant", "Cooling Bay A" telemetry: { metric: string; value: number; unit: string; trend: "up"|"down"|"stable" }[]; dependsOn: string[]; // IDs of upstream assets } ``` **By floor and zone:** | Floor | Zones | Notable | |---|---|---| | Mechanical | Electrical, Backup Power, Chiller Plant | `chiller-a-03` is **critical**, `pump-chw-03/04` are **warning** | | Hall A | Cooling Bay A, Compute Row A, Compute Row B, Power & Network A | All normal | | Hall B | Cooling Bay B, Compute Row C, Compute Row D, Power & Network B | `crah-b-01..04` and `pod-05/06` are **warning** (blast radius) | ### `incidents: Incident[]` — 1 incident ```ts interface Incident { id: string; // 23 (minutes to failure) blastRadius: string[];// 8 downstream asset IDs recommendedAction: string; status: "open" | "dispatched" | "hitl-pending" | "resolved"; // currently "hitl-pending" } ``` ### `technicians: Technician[]` — 3 technicians | id | Name | Status | Certifications | |---|---|---|---| | t1 | Marcus Chen | available | HVAC-R, NFPA-70E, EPA-608, Chiller-Certified | | t2 | Sarah Okafor | transit | HVAC-R, CRAC-Certified, BMS | | t3 | Javier Ruiz | on-site | NFPA-70E, UPS-Certified | ### `jobs: Job[]` — 1 job ```ts interface Job { id: string; title: string; description: string; steps: { id: string; label: string; completed: boolean }[]; // 7 steps, 2 completed assignedAt: string; // "14:34:00" eta: string; // "14:42:00" partsRequired: string[]; } ``` ### Additional exports - `cascadeDelays: Record` — minutes from `chiller-a-03` failure until each downstream asset is affected (4–22 min range) - `telemetryHistory` — 48 data points of CHW supply temp (30-min intervals) for `chiller-a-03`, with an anomaly starting at index 36 - `forecastData` — 9 quantile forecast points (q05/q50/q95) from "now" to "+30m", with a `12.0°C` threshold line --- **Summary for the three target routes:** `/ops/assets`, `/ops/query`, and `/ops/reports` are all unimplemented stubs.
